description: Angular component for a documentation links widget in the Thingsboard UI, managing display, editing, and adding documentation links based on user authority and screen size.

classes.name: DocLinksWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and managing documentation links with responsive layout and user interaction.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets layout based on screen size, and loads documentation links.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions when component is destroyed.

methods.name: loadDocLinks
methods.description: Fetches documentation links from user settings or defaults based on user authority.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit documentation links.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new documentation link.
